name: Kami (Miyagi, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kami town emblem in white: a ring with a five-pointed star and curved strokes, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kami, a town in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 September 2003.

features.role: Kami town emblem — a ring with a five-pointed star and curved strokes, like a stylised character
